title: Paloma Business Exchange-Rate Margin Sheet
content:
Paloma Business payouts are converted at a rate set below the mid-market rate by the plan's exchange-rate margin, expressed in percent. A payout whose principal is at or above the plan's margin reduction threshold receives the reduced margin: the plan's margin less the reduction in percentage points.

| | Paloma Business Starter | Paloma Business Essentials | Paloma Business Growth | Paloma Business Pro | Paloma Business Scale | Paloma Business Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Exchange-rate margin below mid-market (percent) | 1.20 | 0.95 | 0.75 | 0.55 | 0.40 | 0.30 |
| Margin reduction threshold (USD of payout principal) | 10000.00 | 10000.00 | 25000.00 | 50000.00 | 100000.00 | 250000.00 |
| Reduction at or above the threshold (percentage points) | 0.10 | 0.10 | 0.10 | 0.10 | 0.05 | 0.05 |

### Margin in force, by principal

| Plan | Principal below the threshold | Principal at or above the threshold |
|---|---|---|
| Paloma Business Starter | 1.20 percent | 1.10 percent |
| Paloma Business Essentials | 0.95 percent | 0.85 percent |
| Paloma Business Growth | 0.75 percent | 0.65 percent |
| Paloma Business Pro | 0.55 percent | 0.45 percent |
| Paloma Business Scale | 0.40 percent | 0.35 percent |
| Paloma Business Enterprise | 0.30 percent | 0.25 percent |

### Boundary pair (hypothetical principals)

- On Paloma Business Growth, a payout of exactly 25000.00 USD is at the threshold and carries the reduced margin of 0.65 percent.
- On the same plan, a payout of 24999.99 USD is below the threshold and carries the margin of 0.75 percent.
